name: mirage
text: v1.0.20 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.20 . The live bid lane already existed but only bid when the score model was 85%+ sure. Now it also bids on sides the model rates 65-85% (totals over/under and spreads, both sides of different strikes can be up at once), at 15% under the model's fair, and pulls them when the fair no longer clears the bid by 3%. Same desk limits, game must have a trusted ESPN score and clock. Not tested on a live game from here: Diagnostics > LIVE LIGHT will show bid wants/skips.
